summary_en: 8,831,200 shares acquired under commitment-type buyback (FCSR). Post-adjustment final tally after May 14, 2026 ToSTNeT-3 block purchase from Nomura Securities. Average price ¥1,698.52 (arithmetic mean of VWAP May 15–Aug 3, 2026, adjusted +0.176%). Initial purchase 11,210,700 shares; adjustment downward 2,379,500 shares via warrant exercise to warrant holders.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Post-Adjustment for Commitment-Type Share Buyback (FCSR)
translation_en_brief: On 5 August 2026, Tokai Carbon announced completion of post-adjustment settlement for its commitment-type share buyback (FCSR) program announced on 13 May 2026. The final number of acquired shares is 8,831,200 after post-adjustment. The company conducted a ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange block purchase from Nomura Securities on 14 May 2026, initially acquiring 11,210,700 shares. The post-adjustment mechanism then compared the number of shares that would have been acquired at the average price (calculated as the arithmetic mean of VWAP from 15 May to 3 August 2026, multiplied by 100.176%) against the actual number acquired in the block trade. The average price was determined to be ¥1,698.5197. The adjustment resulted in a net decrease of 2,379,500 shares, which were allocated to warrant holders via warrant exercise. The disclosure is a notification of the finalization of share count under the FCSR program's standard post-adjustment methodology.
